LESSON: READING 7.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: VISUALS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How does observation of actual items help us understand what we are taught?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: A learner searches for different information conveyed through visuals.

● Citizenship: A learner discusses national symbols such as the national flag and currency enhances patriotism.

Values:
● Patriotism: A learner discusses visuals like the national flag and visuals on the Kenyan currency.

● Integrity: A learner discusses on the evils of corruption

Link to other subjects:

● Visual arts deal with creating and interpreting visuals.

● Computer sciences – In computer science, computers are used to create and display visuals.

● Humanities, Mathematics, and sciences use visuals like maps, graphs, and charts.

Suggested Learning Resources

Smart braille machine, orbit reader, dot mini and braille me, realia.
